_comment: Cards that exist only for the mana-value cast prohibition test (tests/unit/test_cant_cast_mana_value.py). `t_mv_lock` is Brisela, Voice of Nightmares' last line alone on an enchantment, so the lock can be seen to lift when its source leaves. `t_mv3` and `t_mv4` are vanilla creatures either side of the threshold.

cards.name: Test Mana Value Lock
cards.oracle_text: Your opponents can't cast spells with mana value 3 or less.
